title: Business Development Manager
responsibilities:
• Respond promptly to client inquiries and resolve issues impacting sales engagement and retention.
  • Lead the hiring, onboarding, and training of new sales or SDR team members as needed.
  • Drive business growth by managing sales pipelines, nurturing leads, and converting opportunities across assigned regions (e.g., U.S. states with active opportunities).
  • Analyze CRM and sales data regularly to track performance, refine targeting, and uncover cross-selling opportunities.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly KPIs such as:
    • Of qualified leads generated
    • Revenue closed
    • Outreach and follow-up targets
  • Prepare and deliver monthly and quarterly performance reports to senior leadership with actionable insights.
requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years of proven experience in B2B sales, or business development, ideally within Healthcare RCM or IT services.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong presentation abilities.
  • Ability to build rapport and trust with CXOs, medical practice owners, and IT heads.
  • Strong understanding of sales funnels, outreach tools, CRM workflows, and strategic follow-up techniques.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, delegate effectively, and lead with clarity in a remote/hybrid team environment.
  • Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, or technology management.
  • Experience in selling Healthcare BPO (especially medical billing, coding, and RCM) or custom IT solutions (CRM, ERP, portals, staff augmentation).
  • Exposure to tools like Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Google Workspace
